title: Can You ROLL Your Tongue? (It's Not Just Genes) 👅
description:
Stick out your tongue and try to roll it into a tube. Can't? Don't blame your parents. Your tongue has no bones: it's all muscle, like an octopus arm, and rolling it means curling both edges up at once. School books said one gene decides it, but in a 1952 study, 7 of 33 pairs of identical twins (same genes!) didn't match: one could, one couldn't. Alfred Sturtevant, the geneticist who called it a one-gene trait in 1940, later wrote that he was embarrassed to still see it taught that way. Genes may still play some part, and plenty of kids only learn it as they grow up. Can you? Yes or no?
